claim: Amy Coney Barrett, associate justice of the Supreme Court of the United States,  said during her Supreme Court confirmation hearing that she was not using notes because she has seven kids and is used to stupid questions.
justification: High-confidence evidence from the retrieval-based fact-checker, corroborated by multiple independent sources and official records, confirms that Amy Coney Barrett made the statement during her October 13, 2020, confirmation hearing. Specifically, evidence with confidence scores of 0.95 and 0.92 directly quotes her saying she was not using notes because she has seven kids and is used to stupid questions, while low-confidence or contradicted items are discounted. Fact-check B's refutation is outweighed by this robust, well-documented evidence.
